crossRefs.note: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell…
Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go…
He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the…
Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve Yahweh our God…
Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite…
Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered…
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…

translations.web: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh our God, as he shall command us.”
translations.bsb: We must make a three-day journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the LORD our God as He commands us.”
translations.kjv: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command
translations.asv: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Jehovah our God, as he shall command us.
